en: Namo aṭavakāya majukṭāya | mahāyakṣanāyā maheśvarāya phaṭ | vimaścittrāya phaṭ | nāṭaku.
Vara-paṃ ha ha ha ha paṃ paṃ paṃ haṃ yeṭa yeṭa yeṭa yeṭa nīlaṃbāye gandharvāye piśācāye svāhā | Namo bhagavate vajra-kuṇḍalaye paṃ ||
Vajri-bhasidāya phaṭ | Bhagavati-aṭapaku-ya phaṭ | Vaiśramaṇa phaṭ | Papatāṭaya-ya phaṭ phaṭ ||
Indra yakṣarāja phaṭ | Virocana phaṭ | Vairocana yakṣa na phaṭ | Brahmā phaṭ | Gaccha gaccha svāhā | Mahāyakṣa svāhā | Gaga gaga rala ra phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ.
Maṇibhadra phaṭ | Nārāyaṇa phaṭ | Mahākāla phaṭ | Anudaya phaṭ | Upavandha phaṭ | Sugrīva phaṭ | Namuci phaṭ | Kṛṣṇabūta phaṭ | Yamayama phaṭ.

Mucilinda phaṭ | Sulū-kumbhāṇḍa haṃ phaṭ | Kalyāṇī-guṇavatī phaṭ | Arimardana phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ | Yakṣa yakṣa śīghra śīghra śīghra śīghra svāhā | Mahāyakṣa yakṣa śīghra śīghra śīghra śīghra svāhā | Ā ā ā ā ā ā | Bha bha ccha ccha cchī cchī cchī cchī | Ba ba ra ra vajra ho tra tra tra tra ye phaṭ tra svāhā | Grasa svāhā | Aṭṭa aṭṭa aha aha ha ha ha haṃ phaṭ | Cakrarakṣita-vajra bala bala bala bala pa pa pa pa jja jja jja jja bindu dhāraya siṃharāja huṃ huṃ huṃ huṃ ha ha ha ha phaṭ aṭṭa bhokṣaye svāhā. This mantra is for urgent and evil [occasions].
If you are not pure, do not recite it rashly.
I shall dispatch the King of Ghosts to seize a golden wheel and split your head open.
the Tathāgata has declared their cause."
"The exhaustion of those phenomena through causes and conditions—
this is what the Great Śramaṇa teaches."
